on_rider_enter_event.description: Event id to run on the ridden entity when an entity starts riding it. The game accepts only a string here (an event object is rejected: "unknown child schema option type").

on_rider_exit_event.description: Event id to run on the ridden entity when an entity stops riding it. The game accepts only a string here (an event object is rejected: "unknown child schema option type").

dismount_mode.description:
Defines where riders are placed when dismounting this entity:
- "default", riders are placed on a valid ground position around the entity, or at the center of the entity's collision box if none is found.
- "on_top_center", riders are placed at the center of the top of the entity's collision box.
- "look_direction", riders are placed in the direction the rider looks (format 1.26.60).

seats.description: One seat or the list of seats. Format 1.26.60 accepts only a list: a single seat is written as a one-element list there.
